prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
(none yet)

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
(not available)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 63.2%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 18.5%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Controls Quick-Start Screen: Add a dedicated quick-start guide screen right after home_intro demonstrating desktop shortcuts, tray icon access, and hiding controls. (why: Post-onboarding support contacts frequently cite confusion regarding how to summon, hide, or interact with the pet.)
1: [adoption, new_flow] Interactive Pet Styling Flow: Introduce a dedicated companion style selection step before certificate generation with live visual pet customization. (why: Adoption step has high drop-off (63.2% conversion, 89s median) and custom pet visual generation issues were reported in support.)
2: [sign_in, reorder] Post-Adoption Account Sync: Move the sign-in step to occur immediately after pet adoption certificate creation so users connect their account after forming a bond. (why: Sign-in step currently drops 27.1% of users early; moving account sync after pet creation increases commitment and reduces pet reset reports.)
3: [sign_in, copy] Cloud Backup Account Reassurance: Add clear copy explaining that signing in restores existing pets and prevents loss of companion data across reinstalls. (why: Support received 8 emails regarding pets missing or resetting after signing in again.)
4: [home, hint] Desktop Display Diagnostic Hint: Display explicit system tray and desktop overlay display tips on the waiting screen while the pet is loaded. (why: Multiple support emails reported pets not appearing on the desktop screen or the app failing to open visually.)
5: [home, wait_info] Desktop Rendering Progress Bar: Add real-time progress display and estimated rendering duration during desktop pet initialization. (why: The waiting step before home has a high median completion time of 201s (mean 2336s), causing users to think the app stalled.)
6: [choose_path, layout] Path Selection Card Grid: Change choose_path layout to a grid featuring interactive path preview cards for instant companion vs custom creation. (why: 23.8% of users drop off at choose_path despite spending only 8 seconds, indicating decision ambiguity.)
7: [finish, notification] Desktop Tray Notification Prompt: Enable system tray notification prompt on home_intro so users learn how to re-open or locate their pet window. (why: Support emails showed users being unable to find or re-open the app after completing onboarding.)
